english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a human or animal body, including the fleshly body contrasted with the soul and the torso in contexts such as boxing.
Use 身體 when “flesh” means the human body as a whole rather than its tissue or meat.

examples.english: Exercise can make the body healthier.
examples.traditional: 做運動可以令身體更加健康。
examples.jyutping: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 ling6 san1 tai2 gang3 gaa1 gin6 hong1

examples.english: This disease slowly eats away at the flesh.
examples.traditional: 呢種病會慢慢侵蝕人嘅身體。
examples.jyutping: ne1 zung2 beng6 wui5 maan6 maan2 cam1 sik6 jan4 ge3 san1 tai2

english.note: Use this for physical health understood as the condition of someone’s body, especially in everyday questions about whether someone is well.

examples.jyutping: nei5 san1 tai2 hou2 faan1 mei6 aa3
